conclusion: The same credential authenticates the expected test seller and successfully creates test Orders (HTTP 201). The published adapter now uses Orders, not Payments. Creation, status lookup and idempotent retry succeed in the browser; the provider continues returning processing/in_process without QR. Missing payment scope was a documented explanation of Payments 401, not proof that this credential cannot create orders. Pix QR issuance and approval remain unverified.
